literal: 'What!' saying, things to regret do not do; if one does, again such things not doing is good.
translation: Do not commit acts that will make you cry out, 'What have I done!' If you have made such a mistake, it is good to never repeat it.
modern: 'இப்படிச் செய்துவிட்டேனே!' என்று வருந்தும்படியான செயல்களைச் செய்யக்கூடாது. ஒருவேளை தவறுதலாகச் செய்துவிட்டாலும், மீண்டும் அத்தகைய செயல்களைச் செய்யாமல் இருப்பதே நல்லது.
explanation: This couplet advises against actions that lead to future remorse. The phrase 'எற்று என்று' captures the exclamation of a person regretting their own deed, wondering what they have done. The word 'இரங்குவ' refers to actions that bring such grief. The couplet adds a practical concession: if one happens to make such a mistake, the best course of action is to ensure it is never repeated. This emphasizes that purity of action involves both avoiding regrettable deeds and learning from mistakes.
